name: Incineration
description: Burns away every word on the field. Burned words count toward the level and score their base points (no combo bonus).

name: Frostbinding
description: Freezes every word in place, and stops new words appearing, for 5 seconds. You can keep typing.

name: Temporal Distortion
description: Words fall at half speed for 8 seconds.

name: Arcane Purge
description: Restores the wards: instability returns to 0% and every word loses the extra speed your mistakes gave it.
